title: S8-D4 WordPress signed mutation events + JIT redemption contract
description: Event envelope emitted by the WP MU-plugin (kevin S8-D4) and verified by the central ingest (Jim S8-D1). Signature = HMAC-SHA256(rawJsonBody, S8_WP_EVENT_SECRET), header X-WP-Signature: sha256=<hex>. Replay protection: advisory freshness window on occurred_at + authoritative dedup on (site_id, delivery_id) server-side.

delivery_id.description: per-event unique id for replay dedup

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC; central rejects beyond freshness window

x-ingest-contract.description: Canonical central ingest (Jim S8-D1). Confirmed via hive 2026-08-28T09-00-01-000Z-jim-kevin.

headers.X-WP-Site: optional; site_id is read from the envelope body
headers.x-wp-ts: optional ~60s unix-ms timestamp; freshness also accepted via envelope occurred_at

x-ingest-contract.verify: HMAC-SHA256(rawBody, S8_WP_EVENT_SECRET) hex, compared with timingSafeEqual; generic 401 on miss

x-redemption-contract.description: One-time JIT redemption (WP-side <-> central). No shared/permanent admin password exists (PRD 2.1(5), §11).

body.token: the raw opaque one-time token (central hashes it; sent over TLS)

redeem.response: 200 { grant_id: string, ttl_seconds: integer, requester: string }
redeem.note: central marks token consumed atomically; WP stores token_hash ONLY (hash-only storage) and provisions a short-lived administrator with a single-fire auto-revoke cron.
